headline: License status discussion, a new alcohol license application, a compliance check review, and several one-day license applications.
summary: The board will discuss the status of the all-alcoholic beverages license for the former Mikado Asian Cuisine, consider a new Off-Premise Chapter 15 Green Grocery License for Amnol Market, and review a compliance check at Harrigan's Cork 'N Cask. The board will also review several one-day license applications.

# BEVERLY LICENSE BOARD
# AGENDA
# October 1, 2026

To Whom It May Concern:

There will be a Regular Meeting of the Beverly License Board on Thursday, October 1, 2026, at 6:30 p.m. in the Community Room, Beverly Police Department, 175 Elliott Street, Beverly.

1. Invited In – Mikado Asian Cuisine, Yan Xing Zheng – Discuss the status of all-alcoholic beverages license issued to the former Mikado Asian Cuisine Restaurant that closed in 2025 and provide update as to the plans for the use of this license.

2. Application for new Off-Premise Chapter 15 Green Grocery License granted under Special Legislation from Deep Saini, LLC dba Amnol Market, Sukhwinder Singh, Manager for the sale of all alcoholic beverages at 268-272 Rantoul Street, Beverly.

3. Invited In – JK Harrigan's dba Harrigan's Cork 'N Cask Gregory Saulnier, Manager to discuss recent compliance check performed by Beverly Police Department whereby alcohol was sold to an underage operative.

4. One Day License Applications:
   a. Trustees of Reservations-Long Hill: discuss designated area for Halloween on the Hill
   b. Stentiford @ Carriage House (10/17)
   c. Endicott College School of Nursing (10/20)
   d. Farms Prides Community Assoc. (date change to 10/24)
   e. Cove Improvement Assoc (10/23)
   f. Gentile Brewing (10/17 and 11/8)

Any additional applications that may be received before 3:00 pm on 10/1/2026.

5. Other New Business, if any

6. Upcoming Meetings:
November 5 at 6:30 pm
December 3 at 3:30 pm* – Annual Renewal Meeting (note: earlier start time)

Martha A Lewis
Clerk
